title: Elevated Cat Bowls Set - Raised Cat Food And Water Bowl Set With Non Slip Stand - Pet Feeding Station With 2 Stainless Steel Bowls
body_html:
• Reduces Neck Strain: The elevated cat food bowl allows cats to eat or drink in a more correct position for comfort. Perfect for both kittens and adult cats. Suitable for older cats with arthritis or other mobility-limiting issues.
  • Less Vomiting: This elevated cat bowl set features a 5.7-inch wide stand and 1.2-inch shallow stainless steel bowls, thoughtfully designed to suit the needs of indoor cats. The elevated cat bowl put a cat's mouth at a suitable position in relation to its stomach, it helps cat swallow more easily and alleviates their occasional vomiting.
  • Non-slip support: The four feet of the shelf are equipped with a non-slip base to prevent tipping and sliding during meals. Let the cat focus more on enjoying the food.
  • Splash-proof edges: The platform has splash-proof edges, which can prevent food and water from spilling onto the floor, keeping the dining area clean and tidy.
  • Easy to clean: Two stainless steel bowls are easy to remove and can be washed in the dishwasher, making cleaning easy and quick.
